Deliverables: 1) Dispatcher holds Box<dyn Selector> with a with_selector slot and a SelectorKind serde enum in gateway-core (default P2C, zero behavior change, statistical tests stay green); 2) WeightedRandom Selector (new-api same-tier semantics: static weight only, hard gates and sticky boost identical to P2C, degenerate totals degrade to uniform); 3) priority tiers via channel settings.priority — only the highest-priority tier with an eligible candidate competes, lower tiers reachable when higher-tier candidates are excluded/cooling; 4) context fit via channel settings.context_window — unfit windows dropped before tiers, overflow failures raise the dispatch floor so escalation lands only on strictly larger windows, unlimited channels stay neutral.

+/// Which scheduling strategy the dispatcher's selection layer runs.
+///
+/// Configuration data (serde), resolved by the assembly into a `Selector`
+/// implementation at construction. The strategies share the hard gates
+/// (enable bit, per-request exclusion, cooldown) and the sticky prior-boost
+/// contract; they differ in how they choose among the eligible pool:
+///
+/// - [`SelectorKind::P2c`] — power-of-two-choices by effective prior
+///   (weight × slow-start ramp × sticky boost), posterior likelihood
+///   comparison (latency × health × concurrency × token × throughput);
+///   the default.
+/// - [`SelectorKind::WeightedRandom`] — weighted random by static weight
+///   alone (new-api same-tier semantics): no posterior adjustment, decay and
+///   recovery live entirely in the cooldown / health layer.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
+#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
+pub enum SelectorKind {
+    /// Power-of-two-choices (the historical default).
+    #[default]
+    P2c,
+    /// Weighted random by static weight across the eligible pool.
+    WeightedRandom,
+}
+

 /// Controls only the attempt budget; "which status codes are retryable" is decided

@@ -22,3 +22,33 @@ pub fn classify_channel_scope(status: u16) -> FailureScope {
         _ => FailureScope::Request,
     }
 }
+
+/// Detects the context-window-exceeded family of upstream errors (the request does
+/// not fit the selected model's context window).
+///
+/// Matched case-insensitively against the upstream error **message preview** (the
+/// 2048-byte lossy decode forward already carries); providers phrase it differently
+/// — `OpenAI` returns the `context_length_exceeded` code, Anthropic "prompt is too
+/// long", Gemini "exceeds the maximum number of tokens". Extend the list when a new
+/// provider phrasing shows up in production logs; a false negative degrades to the
+/// pre-existing behavior (the error passes through, no escalation), a false positive
+/// only costs one extra dispatch round.
+#[must_use]
+pub fn is_context_overflow(status: u16, message: &str) -> bool {
+    if !matches!(status, 400 | 413) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    let message = message.to_ascii_lowercase();
+    [
+        "context_length_exceeded",
+        "maximum context length",
+        "context length",
+        "prompt is too long",
+        "exceeds the maximum number of tokens",
+        "context window",
+        "too many input tokens",
+        "input tokens exceed",
+    ]
+    .iter()
+    .any(|needle| message.contains(needle))
+}

claims: The Dispatcher holds the selection layer as Box<dyn Selector> behind an internal SelectorSlot enum; Dispatcher::with_selector installs a custom Box<dyn Selector>; the three knob builders (with_token_budget / with_latency_digest / with_sticky_boost) still mutate the built-in P2CSelector and are inert for a custom selector.
gateway-core defines SelectorKind (serde tagged snake_case, Default = P2c) with variants P2c and WeightedRandom, re-exported through gateway-core's lib and the facade.

A WeightedRandom Selector implementation exists in selector.rs: weighted random by static unit weight only (no health/latency/concurrency/token posterior), the same hard gates as P2C (enable bit, exclusion set, cooldown), sticky boost as a weight multiplier with the same clamp contract, urgent recall of the shortest cooldown on an exhausted pool, and degenerate totals (all-zero / non-finite) degrading to a uniform draw.

Priority tiers are data-driven via channel settings.priority: Dispatcher::select filters the pool to the highest-priority tier with an eligible candidate (eligibility mirrors the selector's hard gates: enable bit, exclusion, cooldown), the tier filter re-runs inside the rate-limit loop per refusal, and sticky does not cross tiers.

Context fit is data-driven via channel settings.context_window: candidates whose window cannot hold prompt estimate + output budget are dropped before tiers; a missing/zero window is unlimited and always fits.

Context-overflow escalation: failure_scope::is_context_overflow detects the context-window-exceeded family; AttemptOutcome::WindowOverflow exists; settle_attempt raises Failover.min_context past the failed candidate's window so the next selection lands only on strictly larger windows; an unlimited-channel overflow passes the stashed error through.

DispatchStage computes the initial floor with gateway-metering's estimate_prompt_tokens (prompt estimate + requested max tokens, 4096 default) and RequestCtx now carries requested_max_tokens promoted from the gate chain; the new gateway-dispatch -> gateway-metering dependency edge is recorded in README and the root Cargo.toml layout comment.
The daemon grows an optional [dispatch] config table (selector = p2c | weighted_random, boot-fixed) wired into the facade Config; config/gateway.toml documents it.

The default path is behavior-identical: the full P2C statistical contract suite passes unchanged (all 5 test files), and the whole workspace suite is green (723 tests run: 723 passed, 1 skipped) under cargo nextest.
Local gates pass on the final tree: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --profile ci with -D warnings is clean, cargo fmt --check is clean, and just verify reports success.

feat(dispatch): pluggable selection strategies, priority tiers, context fit

The selection layer was frozen at one concrete strategy: the Dispatcher held
P2CSelector by value even though the Selector trait and its statistical test
suite were designed for swapability. This change makes the strategy pluggable
and adds two data-driven dispatch filters. The default path (P2C, no priority
in settings, no context_window in settings) is behavior-identical — the
statistical contract suite (p2c_selector / p2c_token_load / p2c_tps /
p2c_vs_brpc / sticky_prior) stays green byte for byte.

## What

1. Pluggable selector slot. The Dispatcher holds Box<dyn Selector> behind an
   internal slot enum; the historical knob builders (with_token_budget /
   with_latency_digest / with_sticky_boost) keep mutating the built-in P2C
   selector, and with_selector installs a custom one. Custom selectors receive
   the shared state (concurrency slots / token budget / latency digest) at
   their own construction — the same Arcs the forward stage holds, so a custom
   strategy reads the same signals the built-in one does. Knob builders called
   after with_selector are inert (documented ordering contract).
2. gateway-core grows SelectorKind (serde config data on the injection
   surface): p2c (default) and weighted_random — the new-api same-tier policy
   as a second Selector implementation: weighted random by static weight only,
   decay/recovery living in the cooldown/health layer, hard gates and sticky
   boost identical to P2C, degenerate totals degrading to a uniform draw.
3. Priority tiers, data-driven via channel settings.priority (i64, default 0):
   only the highest-priority tier with an eligible candidate competes; lower
   tiers become reachable automatically when every higher-tier candidate is
   excluded or cooling (the tier filter re-runs per selection round and inside
   the rate-limit loop). Tier descent is the filter re-running, not a
   dedicated code path. Sticky does not cross tiers.
4. Context fit, data-driven via channel settings.context_window (u64, 0 or
   missing = unlimited): a window that cannot hold prompt estimate + output
   budget is dropped before tiers (feasibility precedes preference);
   context-overflow failures raise the dispatch floor (Failover.min_context)
   so escalation lands only on strictly larger windows; unlimited channels
   stay neutral and an unbounded overflow passes the real error through.
   DispatchStage computes the floor from gateway-metering's
   estimate_prompt_tokens (new dependency edge gateway-dispatch →
   gateway-metering, recorded in README + root layout comment).

## Changelog

- gateway-core: SelectorKind enum added (serde, injection surface) — additive.
- gateway-dispatch: Dispatch::select signature gains a min_context parameter
  (breaking for direct implementors — the workspace has exactly one: the
  Dispatcher; test doubles updated). Dispatcher grows with_selector (additive).
- gateway-forward: retry-loop closures gain the floor parameter (internal).
- gateway-daemon: [dispatch] config table (selector = "p2c" | "weighted_random"),
  boot-fixed; documented in config/gateway.toml.
